about: Agent connect step 7.16, deleting a memory (docs/plans/agent-connect-plan.md §3.15): the memories list (frame 57) and the delete sheet (frame 23), with what Delete came to. Same form as agent-connect-screens.json, which the catalogue (screenCatalogue.test.tsx) reads with this file; the drawings are __tests__/fixtures/screenStatesDelete.tsx. The views are behind the flag and unreachable until the wiring places them.
